item.title: Churches helping millions of Brits get by as living costs remain high
item.description: Across the country, people are looking to the church for help.

item.title: Abortion rises in Northern Ireland for fourth year running
item.description: Abortion was legalised in Northern Ireland in 2019.

item.title: Marriage is the safest relationship, latest figures suggest
item.description: Of the eight children murdered during lockdown, 7 were killed thanks to the actions of a step parent or new partner.

item.title: Princess of Wales to lead Westminster Abbey carol service, celebrating kindness and community
item.description: This evening, the Princess of Wales, Catherine, is set to revisit Westminster Abbey to preside over her fifth Together at Christmas carol service - a seasonal gathering that places acts of kindness and community at the heart of its celebrations.

item.title: Many Western Christians misunderstand the purpose of faith, says NT Wright
item.description: Instead of seeing Christianity as the story of God renewing the whole cosmos — Heaven and Earth united — they have been taught to think of salvation primarily as a private escape plan: the soul departing for Heaven when the body dies.

item.title: The bishop who became Santa Claus
item.description: Everybody knows Santa Claus. But how many people know the inspiration for the jolly Father Christmas was in fact a bishop whose courage, generosity, and compassion shaped centuries of Christian practice?

item.title: Thousands attend launch of nationwide Christmas evangelistic campaign at Royal Albert Hall
item.description: A major evangelistic outreach for the Christmas season formally got underway this week at the Royal Albert Hall.

item.title: Samaritan’s Purse plane hijacked; suspect in custody
item.description: A Samaritan's Purse plane carrying aid to South Sudan was hijacked earlier this week. A suspect has been detained, and no serious injuries are being reported.

item.title: Evangelical Alliance updates Christian course for South Asian seekers
item.description: The Evangelical Alliance (EA) has announced the launch of a new set of resources aimed at introducing the gospel to people of South Asian heritage.

item.title: Burnout and isolation are common problems for Church of England clergy - report
item.description: Clergy described burnout, feelings of isolation, diminished morale, and ongoing financial strain.
